proposition: Sources disagree on the year of death (830 in printed Khwāndamīr, 836 in a manuscript); Melvin-Koushki holds 835 is right, since 830 is excluded by works written after that date and news of a death two weeks before the end of 835 would reach Fars only in 836.

mediation.who: Khwāndamīr, Ḥabīb al-Siyar, as reported by Bahār

mediation.note: MK's reasoning from a later date of news
